# percolation_winding_on_binary_grid { #mofography.winding_percolation.percolation_winding_on_binary_grid }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> End-to-end 2D lattice demo calling make_periodic_graph_from_binary_grid.

```python
winding_percolation.percolation_winding_on_binary_grid(
    grid,
    allow_diagonals=False,
    verbose=False,
)
```

Run winding percolation on a 2D binary periodic lattice (demo / tests).



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

grid : np.ndarray
    Binary 2D lattice treated as periodic in x/y.
allow_diagonals : bool
    When ``True`` includes diagonal neighbors as valid connections.
verbose : bool
    Print a human-readable summary when enabled.
